{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: give your agent a browser with a persistent identity - engine-level fingerprint spoofing, unlimited free local profiles, Android device emulation, passkeys that survive, and residential proxy egress.","id":"gh:1336543323","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-antibrow","slug":"antibrow/dsh-antibrow","topics":["agent-tools","ai-agents","android-emulation","anti-detect-browser","browser-automation","browser-fingerprinting","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","fingerprint-browser","mcp","mcp-server","playwright","residential-proxy","web-automation"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin: give your agent a browser with a persistent identity - engine-level fingerp"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rint spoofing, unlimited free local profiles, Android device emulation, passkeys that survive, and r"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"esidential proxy egress."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-antibrow"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that
gives the agent a browser with an identity."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"The browser is AntiBrow: a Chromium fork with fingerprint
configuration at engine level, driven thro"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ugh the standard Playwright API. SDK docs are
at antibrow.com/docs, and the dated detection measurem"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ents -
including the checks that fail - are at antibrow.com/reports."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why not a plain browser plugin"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Every other browser plugin hands the agent a fresh Chromium. That is fine for
reading a public page "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"and useless for anything behind a login: the session dies
with the process, the fingerprint is a sto"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ck automation build, and the traffic
leaves from your machine."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| | A plain Playwright plugin | dsh-antibrow |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Identity between runs | new browser every time | one persistent profile per name |
| Logins | gone"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" when the process ends | cookies and passkeys persist, optionally synced across machines |
| Fingerp"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"rint | stock build, patched from page scripts | spoofed inside the engine, before any page script ru"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ns |
| Egress | your own IP | residential proxy, with timezone, language and reported connection fol"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"lowing its exit |
| Parallel identities | one data directory to share | one isolated profile per age"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"nt or per account |
| Tabs | start from nothing | last session restored, so the agent resumes where "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"count |
| Tabs | start from nothing | last session restored, so the agent resumes where it stopped |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The difference shows up the first time an agent has to *be someone*: check a
mailbox, watch a dashbo"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ard, keep a marketplace account warm. A browser with no
memory has to log in again on every run, and"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" logging in again is exactly what a
site treats as suspicious."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What it brings"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Unlimited profiles, on the free tier.** Not five, not fifty - profiles live
on your disk, not on"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" a plan, and creating one costs nothing. Give every
account, every marketplace, every persona its ow"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"n browser and stop reasoning
about which cookie jar the agent is holding. Syncing them between machi"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"nes and
the managed residential proxies are the paid parts; the profiles themselves
never are.
- **1"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"6 tools** for the model: sessions, profiles, proxies, page control, live
view. All under `mcp__antib"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"row__*`, all reachable from Code Mode as ordinary
async calls.
- **An Android phone, from the same A"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"PI.** One argument - `deviceType:
'android'` - and the agent is a phone: touch points, mobile client"},{"id":"p12s8","text":" hints,
phone viewport, phone GPU. See below.
- **Engine-level spoofing.** The user agent, platform,"},{"id":"p12s9","text":" screen, fonts, canvas,
WebGL and audio are answered by the engine itself. Nothing is injected into
"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"the page, so there is no injected script for a detector to find.
- **A coherent story, not a pile of"},{"id":"p12s11","text":" overrides.** Timezone, locale and the
reported network profile are derived from the proxy's real ex"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"it, because a US
IP that reports Shanghai time is a contradiction a page can check in one line.
- **"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"Passkeys survive.** WebAuthn credentials are stored with the profile, not in
the machine's keychain,"},{"id":"p12s14","text":" so a passkey registered on one run still signs in on
the next - and, with sync on, on another compu"},{"id":"p12s15","text":"ter.
- **Watch it work.** `start_live_view` streams the agent's browser to a
dashboard, so a long un"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"attended run is something you can look at instead of
guess about.
- **Identities from real machines."},{"id":"p12s17","text":"** On a paid plan a profile can be minted from
a captured real-device fingerprint rather than a gene"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"rated one - a whole
coherent row off one physical machine, not a field-by-field invention.
- **Four "},{"id":"p12s19","text":"builds, three operating systems**: Windows, macOS, and Linux on both
x86_64 and arm64. The same prof"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"ile runs on any of them.
- **Portable, and not only to agents.** Export a profile as a file and impo"},{"id":"p12s21","text":"rt it
on another machine; leave it unsynced and it is still there, in the desktop
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### The phone"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Android profiles are built from whole captured devices - the screen, the GPU
report and the client h"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ints agree with each other because they came off the same
physical phone, and the plugin picks a row"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" rather than assembling one. Three of
them ship inside the package, so a free-tier agent can create "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"an Android profile
with no network round trip at all."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The device type is fixed when the profile is created and never drifts
afterwards: a profile that was"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" a phone stays that phone. Android needs engine
151 or newer - if none is available the launch fails"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" rather than quietly handing
you a desktop browser that claims to be a phone."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Measured"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"On a macOS host, through a US residential proxy, 2026-08-15, engine 151:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Check | Result |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| whoer.net disguise | 90% |
| creepjs headless signal | 0% |
| creepjs stealth signal | 0% |
| cree"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"pjs platform hints | `Arial, "Segoe UI"` - no font from the host |
| Reported platform vs user agent"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" | agree (Win32 / Windows) |
| Timezone vs proxy exit | agree (America/Los_Angeles) |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The 10% whoer deducts is WebRTC, which had no route to a STUN server on that
run. Reproduce all of i"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"t with `tests/smoke` - the harness is in this repository,
and it fails loudly rather than printing a"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" number nobody checks."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Verified against dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` and `anti-detect-browser` 2.19.1, 2026-08-15.
DeepSeek Harness is "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"a developer preview and says it will break compatibility;
this line is the claim, and it rots withou"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"preview and says it will break compatibility;
this line is the claim, and it rots without a re-test."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The SDK version floor is real: 2.19.1 is the first release whose close path ends
the browser process"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" instead of only dropping the debugging connection. On an
older one a closed session leaves the brow"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ser running, which keeps that
profile's directory locked - the next launch of it dies before the deb"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"ugging
connection is ready - and holds a concurrency slot for the rest of the run."}],"truncated":true}
